correctness.rationale: Built the exact 32-vertex 48-edge cubic Dyck graph as adjacency of the 32 Shrikhande triangles. Recursive matching enumeration using the least uncovered vertex proves and independently reproduced all 417 perfect matchings with no duplicates. For each unordered matching pair, exactly one permitted simple alternating length-l flip occurs precisely when the symmetric difference has l edges and its nontrivial degree-2 subgraph is connected. Independently recomputed the 864/96/2736 edges for lengths 6/8/10, components 45+124+124+124 for cutoff 8, 3696 combined edges and connectivity for cutoff 10, and full-source BFS eccentricities 360 at 4 and 57 at 5. Independently constructed checks establish radius 4 and diameter 5 and 8+10-only connectivity. Exhaustion follows from explicit finite recursion and pairwise testing, not from sampling or a timeout; the result is only for this Dyck graph.
